audit.whatIsWrong: (a) Three fields claim Feast's true damage 'ignores the grey health from Thick Skin'. Thick Skin's active converts stored damage into a SHIELD, and shields absorb true damage — so the page tells you to spend an 80-second execute into the one thing that eats it. That is the most consequential error on the page. (b) The stun is described as 'three An Acquired Taste stacks (Q plus two autos) stun you'. Riot's text is that Tongue Lash applies a stack and, if the target ALREADY has three, that cast stuns and consumes them — so it is the next Tongue Lash after three stacks, not the third stack itself. (c) MISSING: Tongue Lash heals Tahm Kench when it hits a champion — his poke is sustain, and the page never says so. (d) MISSING: those same three stacks are the requirement for Devour on an enemy, so he must choose between stunning you and eating you. Nothing on the page mentions the gate.
audit.why: Riot text — An Acquired Taste: 'gaining extra damage based on his total health... At three stacks, he can use Devour on an enemy champion.' Tongue Lash: 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s, 900 range, 'damaging and slowing the first unit hit and healing himself if he strikes an enemy champion... If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.' Thick Skin: 3s cooldown, 'Passive: stores a percent of the damage he takes and heals based on it while out of combat. Active: Convert all stored damage into a temporary shield.' Abyssal Dive: 21/20/19/18/17s, 1000-1200 range, knockup. Devour: no cooldown listed.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Abyssal Dive with no number and called Thick Skin nothing at all.
audit.why: Abyssal Dive at 21s is the whole reason the silence wins this lane — bait it and he is stuck in the knockup. Thick Skin at 3s is the opposite: it is never down, so the plan has to be spending it, not waiting for it.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal cue anywhere, despite two separate healing sources in his kit.
audit.why: Tongue Lash heals on champion hit and Thick Skin's passive heals him out of combat off stored damage — an attrition lane against him without Grievous Wounds is a longer lane than it needs to be.

notes:
The packet's one suspectName for this matchup, "Feral Scream's" in mid, is a FALSE POSITIVE — correct name with a possessive. No change proposed.

The single most dangerous line on this page was 'Feast's true damage ignores the grey health from Thick Skin', repeated three times. Thick Skin's active is a shield, and shields absorb true damage — a player following that advice spends an 80-second execute into the exact ability that eats it. All three occurrences are corrected to say the opposite: spend his shield first.

The phrase 'grey health' is used throughout for Thick Skin. Riot's text describes stored damage converted to a temporary shield plus an out-of-combat heal, and never uses 'grey health'. I kept the term where it was doing no harm (wants.you[1], early, late) to hold the edit count down, but it is imprecise and a future pass could normalise it.
